responsibility: Manages cargo registration (origin, destination, arrival deadline), unique tracking identifiers, destination changes, and cargo lifecycle state. Owns the cargo aggregate and enforces booking business rules including origin/destination validity and routing status (not routed, routed in transit, delivered).

Computes and provides candidate routes (itineraries) compatible with a cargo's origin, final destination, and arrival deadline using graph traversal/pathfinding, returning feasible route legs with load/unload points and expected dates.

Registers logistics events (receive, load, unload, customs, claim) across multiple operational channels (operational UI, integration REST service, and periodic file batch processing), validates events against existing cargo/location/voyage, rejects invalid events for later audit, and triggers recalculation of cargo delivery status.
communicates_with: Cargo Booking Service;Voyage Service;Location Service;Tracking Service

responsibility: Provides cargo tracking and monitoring by tracking identifier, exposing current status, last known location, estimated arrival, event history distinguishing expected vs off-plan events, geographic support, misdirection signaling, and consolidated administrative views for monitoring channels.
Maintains voyages and their schedules used to associate load/unload events and to validate route legs against transport movements.
Manages the catalog of logistic locations available for selection as cargo origins, destinations, and event locations.
